name: Image-based Voxelization
aliases: Image-based Voxelization — Multiple Image to Schematic Conversion
definition: Converts a list of 2D images into a 3D schematic where the image index becomes the Y-axis (depth), and image pixels map to X and Z axes.
summary: Image-based Voxelization converts 2D images into 3D schematics, distinguished by its excavate mode that creates terraced structures by clipping voxel columns based on neighbor transparency.
